windows.preferred_guidance: The preferred period ends as daylight becomes bright (isfar), before sunrise. This draft has no validated brightness model, so it does not assign that sign a clock time or substitute the sunrise boundary.

Pray promptly after the time enters, allowing for the necessary preparation. This early-performance recommendation is not a separate fixed-minute deadline; the one-shadow boundary remains the outer end.

The preferred period ends at the noon shadow plus twice the object’s height. The later permissible period continues to sunset. This two-shadow endpoint does not change the one-shadow start in this Shafi‘i profile.

Pray promptly after sunset with the necessary preparation. No universal minute cutoff is assigned to this recommendation. The extended-time opinion used here retains the end of red twilight as the outer boundary.
The preferred period ends at the first third of the night, measured here from sunset to the following true dawn. The outer boundary remains that following dawn.
